metadata.total_displaced_note: Sum of the population field. For 1948 villages this is the 1945 population (Village Statistics); for recent entries it is the displaced or at-risk figure given in the source. Rows without a figure are not counted.
data_sources: Palestine Open Maps - localities dataset (github.com/PalOpenMaps/pom-data), cross-referenced to Zochrot, Palestine Remembered, Abu Sitta Atlas of Palestine 1948 and PalQuest
Benny Morris - The Birth of the Palestinian Refugee Problem Revisited (2004)
UN OCHA oPt - Humanitarian Situation Updates and demolition/displacement data
UN OHCHR - Destruction of Palestinian refugee camps in northern West Bank (Sep 2026)
B'Tselem - Israeli Information Center for Human Rights
Jerusalem Story / Institute for Palestine Studies

1948-1949.description: Nakba Period - Systematic ethnic cleansing during 1948 war

undated.description: Depopulated around 1948 (mostly Naqab/Negev Bedouin communities) - exact date not recorded

1950-1966.description: Post-Nakba - Continued displacement under military rule

1967.description: Six-Day War - Villages destroyed in West Bank, East Jerusalem and Golan Heights

1967-2023.description: Occupation Era - Ongoing demolitions and displacements

2023-present.description: Current Period - Gaza war, settler violence, camp operations and demolitions

massacre.label: Massacre
massacre.description: Direct killing of civilians to force displacement

forced_expulsion.label: Forced Expulsion
forced_expulsion.description: Direct orders forcing residents to leave

fear_of_attack.label: Fear of Attack
fear_of_attack.description: Displacement due to fear of military action

settler_violence.label: Settler Violence
settler_violence.description: Attacks and intimidation by Israeli settlers forcing communities to leave

eviction.label: Eviction
eviction.description: Court-ordered or legal-process evictions from homes

military_demolitions.label: Military Demolitions
military_demolitions.description: Mass house demolitions carried out by the military

depopulated.label: Depopulated
depopulated.description: Residents expelled or fled; village emptied and mostly destroyed

depopulated_built_over.label: Depopulated & Built Over
depopulated_built_over.description: Village site built over by an Israeli locality

depopulated_appropriated.label: Depopulated & Appropriated
depopulated_appropriated.description: Palestinian population expelled; buildings taken over (e.g. Jaffa, Haifa, Lydda)

destroyed_depopulated.label: Destroyed & Depopulated
destroyed_depopulated.description: Town levelled and emptied of its residents

partially_destroyed_rebuilt.label: Partially Destroyed, Rebuilt
partially_destroyed_rebuilt.description: Partly demolished; residents later returned and rebuilt

destroyed_rebuilt.label: Destroyed, Rebuilt
destroyed_rebuilt.description: Demolished; later rebuilt by returning residents

rebuilt_nearby.label: Rebuilt Nearby
rebuilt_nearby.description: Expelled residents re-established the village nearby

displaced_no_return.label: Displaced, Return Barred
displaced_no_return.description: Residents expelled and prevented from returning

under_threat.label: Under Threat
under_threat.description: Currently facing demolition or displacement threats
